question: Do model-predicted totals track actual totals?
Does last week's margin predict this week's margin for the same team?
interpretation: Near zero means week-to-week results are mostly noise, so recency weighting cannot add much. Descriptive only: n counts team-game pairs and each game supplies both teams' margins, so the pairs are not independent; no interval and no p-value are published (F55).

question: Calibration: slope of actual margin on the model's predicted margin (1.0 = perfectly scaled)
interpretation: Slope 0.89 (SE 0.28), intercept -0.79. 95% t interval 0.328 to 1.443 (df 87); p = 0.6830 against the calibration target slope 1.0, so at this sample size the slope is not distinguishable from 1. Interval and p use the slope's own standard error, not the correlation formula (F48 correction applied, T51). Model diagnostic only: the predictor is a model output (DEC-09).

question: Are the side leg and the total leg of the same game correlated (phi)?
interpretation: Parlay pricing: |phi| > 0 means the independence shortcut misprices the ticket.
